end-behavior-growth.alt: Left: the graph of f(x) = (2x² + x)/(x² + 1) for x from −10 to 10 with the dashed horizontal asymptote y = 2. The graph crosses the asymptote at x = 2 and then approaches it from above. Right: ln x, x³ and eˣ for x from 0 to 6. At first x³ is above eˣ, but eˣ passes it near x = 4.54 and stays ahead; ln x grows slowest.
